response.sql: WITH driver_counts AS (SELECT d.driverId, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_records FROM drivers AS d LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId), driver_average AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_records) AS average_records FROM driver_counts) SELECT dc.driverId, dc.qualifying_records, 1.0 * dc.qualifying_records / da.average_records AS ratio_to_average FROM driver_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN driver_average AS da ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, dc.driverId ASC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average includes every driver in drivers, including drivers with no qualifying records.

alternatives.interpretation: The average includes only drivers who have at least one qualifying record.
alternatives.sql: WITH driver_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_records FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), driver_average AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_records) AS average_records FROM driver_counts) SELECT dc.driverId, dc.qualifying_records, 1.0 * dc.qualifying_records / da.average_records AS ratio_to_average FROM driver_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN driver_average AS da ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, dc.driverId ASC LIMIT 10
